requirements.text: 0 and 28 church-local days qualify; 29 does not; unknown target remains Unknown.
Uncompleted past target is overdue; explicit move/postpone preserves history and no automatic phase/date writes.
Calendar launch-window clocks never substitute for 72 elapsed release hours or 48h contact performance.

All nine milestone and 23 actual source-task identities remain with human completion; aggregate counts never automatically complete them. Preserve every actual task rather than force the former incorrect summary count.
Reopening/correcting required linked work makes current evidence Needs review while retaining previous human completion history.

Current valid re-confirmation uses current subject authority, expected revision and a fresh linked-task digest. Open linked tasks do not block completion. Old completion history is not erased or relabelled.
Dedicated practice discriminant appears in create/list/filter/detail without silently recategorizing team rehearsal or Vision.

behavior_rules.rule: Canonical pre_launch_practice actual-held occurrence; no Vision artifacts or implicit training/phase effects.

requirements.text: Three distinct actually held completed practice IDs count once; four remain satisfied and replay never adds events.

behavior_rules.rule: Visible information for plant_member: actual completed meeting ids, distinct occurrence count, source references.

requirements.text: Scheduled-only/future/cancelled/not-held practice records are not evidence; completion requires actual nonfuture occurrence.
Attendance finalization, guest rows or task ticks never complete/duplicate a practice occurrence.
Corrected occurrence/date/type and reopened/void duplicate change current count while preserving history and previous PI snapshot.

behavior_rules.rule: Supported actual occurrence state values: completed, not_completed.

requirements.text: Merely hiding/archiving a genuine completed practice is distinguished from voiding invalid occurrence.
Ordinary practice agenda/venue/guests remain usable; no Vision number/kit/card/evaluation/auto-first-timer tasks or team training credit.
Reaching three actual practices grants no account authority and never advances phase or completes nine milestones/the 23 actual source Tasks.
Current meeting/launch operations preserve scoped shared administration; no team-leader exception expansion or foreign event write.
Exact-reviewed Evry practice create/complete/correct uses shared domain operations with stale/duplicate receipts and current authority.
Promotion attestation states the chosen plan was actually executed; optional references, not mandatory every illustrative medium.
One sent communication/task tick is not the whole promotion plan; missing execution evidence remains Unknown.
Native launch debrief questionnaire replaces attestation and keeps outcome counts/notes/capture-the-day separately editable.

Valid submitted No missing guests derives guest criterion Met; Yes positive count derives Notmet; unanswered/draft Unknown. Debrief valid submission separately Met, with actual source wording/history preserved and no unrelated effects.

Native corrections/history preserve versions and current authority. Only valid approved questionnaire evidence derives the two current guest/debrief criterion/milestone states; arbitrary outcome/clock/unchecked edits never complete them. No automatic tasks or phase move.

Native/Evry Launch read/correct/guest/debrief/summary adapters use the same current authority/revision/history; every durable effect exact reviewed, no raw reflection/private-care model input or hidden task/send/phase effect.
Guest minimum name with optional phone/email creates real People without fabricated surname, age/account/membership inference.
Choosing an existing person links its explicit ID; same name never automatically merges and repeated create request is receipt-safe.
Submitted missing guest answer, not headcount/roster/outcomeRecorded, determines guest criterion; Yespositivecount remains reported remaining without roster subtraction and no placeholders.
Owner/Admin opens the durable assessment OR 72 elapsed hours after availability releases it, whichever first.
Delivery/email open/model read/other-member read alone never marks eligible planter opportunity;72h starts at durable availability not queued draft.
Same concern/evidence appears to planter; prior released results remain during new embargo only under current authorization/category scope.
Unreleased new assessment never feeds NI/Location; independent current health/results and all underlying category gates still apply.

Separate human operational summary preview/review/explicit publish has current exact org shared_findings and contributing-category access immediately; raw questionnaire/guest/private care remains private and model assessment 72 hour/human opened gate stays separate.
Native/private author checkins stay outside all model/Evry/org/tool/log/evaluation paths; launch forms cannot import them.

Active target catalog preserves unchanged canonical rubric/Playbook criterion keys and names chosen native practice/debrief commands explicitly. Current source inventory remains separate evidence; a declaration or retained table never manufactures active operation authority.
Actual Launch remains launches/launch_events with actual date separate from planned date; not a public_launch Meeting or Vision subtype.
Entering a new named guest in Launch attendance creates a real People person and Launch relation together; explicit existing-person selection links that person without making a duplicate.
A meaningful supplied name is sufficient; phone/email are optional. No invented surname, address, age, account, invitation or commitment.
Normal duplicate candidate selection is reused; same name is never automatic merge. Repeated create/link cannot double attendance or leave a Person without its intended link on failed transaction.
Headcount remains independent from named guests and reported unentered count; not every counted attendee needs a People record, and anonymous/missing data produces no fake person.
The missing-name question appears once in the debrief; Yes shows only its count field. No Finish guest entry button/receipt/attestation or second confirmation.
A current valid submitted No response derives guest_data_entered Met with dated author-reported questionnaire provenance; headcount zero/non-null or named roster size is not the proof.
A current valid submitted Yes with positive count derives guest_data_entered Not met/remaining and exposes that reported count separately; no automatic subtraction by roster size.
Unanswered or provisional missing-name response is Unknown, never implicit No; a new incomplete draft does not overwrite the last valid submitted evidence.
Valid questionnaire submission gives debrief_done Met independently even when Yes/3 guests remain. Do not require a No to submit or declare the guest criterion Met from submission alone.

All six approved areas are represented; incomplete work saves as draft, deliberate valid submission and later edits retain question/version/actor/history. No new prose minimum, numeric quotas or per-topic menus.
Actual-date/count changes use the canonical Launch correction writer; debrief does not silently change planned date/actual occurrence or mark first_service_complete from narrative.
Correction/no-op/current revision/history remain attributable; changing the missing answer updates current derived criterion while historical readings and already advanced phase remain.

Guest/debrief criterion and corresponding current milestone display use the same native evidence; no second manual checkbox can fake completion. Other milestone/task workflows remain and no phase auto-advance/demotion occurs.
Summary is separately editable short human text, previewed/reviewed before explicit publish; submission alone publishes nothing and raw answer bodies/guest records are not copied automatically.

Published summary read uses current exact-org health/results shared_findings and actual contributing source categories; unrelated/nonaffiliated/revoked/disabled grants deny. No added consent toggle or organization native-write permission.

Published text excludes individual guest information, raw private/support narratives and protected source copies. Human reviews outgoing text; no promised automatic name detection/redaction or model-generated testimony.
Current direct summary becomes available on deliberate publish under current grants; PI/NI/Location assessments still use eligible human opened OR 72 elapsed-hour P15 release independently.
Next-step task creation is a separate previewed/reviewed ordinary Tasks command; questionnaire/summary submission alone creates/completes no task, contact, email, support dispatch or phase.
Native Owner/Admin current plant permissions and exact reviewed Evry writes share operations; Member/foreign/expired/stale operations cannot write guests/debrief/published summary.

Current PI guest/debrief facts use only valid submitted/current corrected questionnaire answer and submission evidence; headcount/outcomeRecorded or arbitrary manual signal never substitutes and canonical SME keys/wording remain unchanged.
Launch link correction or Person merge accounts for active relations without duplicate guest links; scalar headcount and human-reported missing count are not silently recalculated from CRM.

Bounded facts supply submission status, dated missing-name response/count and canonical date/counts to PI. Private check-in or raw reflection/support text never enters a PI evidence projection by accident.

Current plant Owner/Admin sets/moves/postpones/recommits canonical planned local date under expected revision with real YYYY-MM-DD validation and note≤2000. Planning/scheduled/postponed/completed remain explicit; no-op/replay returns original receipt and date/status journal. Moving date does not rewrite task due dates/assignments/status or move phase.
requirements.title: Set, move, postpone and recommit canonical launch date

behavior_rules.rule: Move planned target with history; readiness Task dates stay under Tasks explicit commands, no hidden reviewed milestone dates side effects.
Revisioned postponement changes target/current state and retains prior target history, not actual facts or readiness records.
First schedule atomically creates real Launch and canonical nine milestones/23 undated Tasks; requires actual parent plant, no invented preexisting launch id or automatic Task due-date rewrite.

requirements.text: Launch journal reads scoped before/after planned/actual date/status, event kind, actual actor and occurrence/correction history. Minimal deleted-actor attribution remains without private account payload. Read failure is unavailable, not a fabricated empty journal.
requirements.title: Launch date/status journal and actor names

behavior_rules.rule: Visible information for plant_owner|plant_admin|plant_member: launch id, items, next cursor, as of.

requirements.text: First schedule and fixed nine Playbook milestones/23 actual source undated ordinary launch_prep Tasks initialize in one bounded history/audit/receipt transaction with stable seed identities. Preserve approved wording and existing user edits/deletions; task system owns assignee/date/status. Three actual prelaunch_practice occurrences supply their own evidence; task ticks never fabricate those events.
requirements.title: Nine Playbook milestones and 23 linked preparation tasks

requirements.text: Complete or reopen a readiness milestone under current subject authority and expected revision in the same history/audit/receipt transaction. Completion is allowed with open linked tasks. The linked-task digest compares the reviewed view with current linked tasks and refuses only a stale view; it does not require tasks to be complete. Reopening or correcting linked work makes current evidence Needs review while preserving prior human completion history. Guest/debrief evidence is derived and cannot be overridden by a manual checkbox.
requirements.title: Complete and reopen milestones with a fresh linked-task view

behavior_rules.rule: Commit against the current linked-task digest and source evidence. Open linked tasks are allowed; a changed digest refuses a stale reviewed view. Reopening or correction preserves history and Needs-review evidence without creating a second Task status engine.

requirements.text: Complete/reopen linked Launch prep Tasks only through ordinary task subject/assignee/administration rules. Current milestone progress derives from live Tasks; task deletion/reassignment/reopen changes that projection and never erases prior human completion or gains a Launch authorization bypass.
requirements.title: Complete/reopen linked launch task using ordinary task rules

requirements.text: Record actual nonfuture Launch date/count/outcome separately from target, link real named guests with atomic same-plant Person/relation create or explicit existing selection, and save/submit versioned six-area debrief. A valid submitted No-unentered-guests derives guest_data_entered Met; Yes/positive count derives Not met; draft/unanswered Unknown. Valid submission independently derives debrief_done Met. Separately preview/review/publish human summary under current scoped sharing; no automatic task/contact/email/phase/guest placeholder.
requirements.title: Record Launch Sunday outcome once date arrives

behavior_rules.rule: Actual named Launch guest linkage creates valid Person+relation atomically; single display name permitted. No missing-name questionnaire/count requirement, placeholder, automatic merge, Vision credit/contact/send.
Debrief, actual occurrence, named guests and reviewed published summary remain independent; correction invalidates affected evidence/projection.

Explicit exact reviewed human publication/correction; frozen provenance category union includes baseline Meetings plus actual contributors, unknown mapping fails closed; organization receives only whole published revision under all current required sharing categories.
Record one actual nonfuture Launch occurrence; record does not accept false/void pseudo-occurrence. Corrections/void history use owning correction operation, no target-date actualization.
All questionnaire responses may be absent in draft; null missing-name answer allowed until submission. No arbitrary prose minimum.
Separate human editable summary draft with explicit domain source provenance; never copy raw questionnaire/guest/private support narratives automatically.
Submit exact deliberately reviewed valid draft; completion independent of entering all guest names. No auto-publication, phase Task, contact, recurring services or raw-model input.

requirements.text: Correct canonical actual Launch/date/count/debrief/guest relation/summary under expected revision with before/after actor/history and no-op replay. New incomplete draft preserves last valid submitted evidence. Corrected guest answer updates current derived criterion without erasing old snapshot or silently demoting phase; aggregate headcount/missing count never silently recalc from roster.
requirements.title: Correct recorded outcome with journal/no-op semantics

behavior_rules.rule: Versioned six-area draft/submitted correction; actual date/counts refer to canonical Launch evidence. Valid No asks no count; Yes requires positive count. Later incomplete draft preserves prior valid submission; no quota/attestation/roster subtraction.
Attributed revisioned relink or void of actual guest relation; does not change aggregate attendance/debrief answer or erase history.
Actual outcome counts nullable unknown, independent planned date; nonfuture actual fact/correction/history. Zero differs from unknown, never fabricate counts or Vision follow-up evidence.
Closed patch: absent retains old fact, explicit null means unknown; at least one field present; date correction nonfuture and attributed.

requirements.text: Launch workspace/dashboard uses one church-local countdown and canonical planned/status/actual outcome/readiness facts, explicitly distinguishes zero/unknown/postponed/overdue/completed and exposes named-guest/debrief/summary workflow. Calendar 0..28 day window is distinct from 48 hour follow-up and 72 hour result-release clocks; load error is unavailable.
requirements.title: Launch workspace, dashboard countdown and outcome forms

behavior_rules.rule: Visible information for plant_owner|plant_admin|plant_member: launch id, planned local date, countdown days, state, as of.
Purpose-specific Launch query uses required real parent IDs and trusted server as of; countdown/history never require or disclose raw questionnaire/guest DTO.
Visible information for plant_owner|plant_admin|plant_member: launch id, planned local date, actual facts, state, milestones, debrief complete, published summary, completeness.
Visible information for plant_owner|plant_admin: launch id, actual facts, debrief draft, submitted revision, six area answers, summary draft, published summary, history, completeness.
Native owning human questionnaire/draft/history read
Visible information for plant_member: launch id, actual facts, submitted revision, debrief complete, missing name answer, unentered guest count, published summary, completeness.
Approved bounded submission/current actual evidence and published summary only

Visible information for plant_owner|plant_admin|plant_member: launch id, actual facts, submitted revision, debrief complete, missing name answer, unentered guest count, published summary, completeness.
Bounded evidence only; no raw questionnaire/support/guest/private care input
Native raw editable draft/questionnaire/support text restricted to current plant Owner/Admin; Member and Evry projections contain approved bounded evidence/published summary only.

requirements.text: Repair partial initialization by stable launch/milestone/task seed identity under current plant/source revision, creating incomplete-initialization items exactly once. Retained seed receipts and task/link tombstones distinguish deliberate user deletion, which repair never resurrects. Existing edits/completion/history survive and no arbitrary recurring service or automatic readiness completion is created.
requirements.title: Converge missing readiness after seed failure

behavior_rules.rule: Owning transaction internal exact canonical nine/23 identities; repair only incomplete initialization, retained Task/link tombstones never resurrect deliberate deletion. Domain atomic transaction is trusted caller context, not a serialized input.

requirements.text: Read milestone completion, reopening and correction history with the actual named actor or minimal scrubbed deleted attribution and original event times. Reconfirmation uses the current linked-task digest and allows open tasks. Keep prior completion history without relabelling it as a new past fact.
requirements.title: Milestone completion history and named actor

behavior_rules.rule: Visible information for plant_owner|plant_admin|plant_member: milestone id, items, next cursor, as of.

requirements.text: Recurring post-launch services/worship/volunteer scheduling is outside the active target; source declarations create no operation. Phase-six post-launch 48 hour guest follow-up remains Unknown/unmeasured without an approved actual obligations/contact/time origin, never substituted by prelaunch Vision success.
requirements.title: Recurring services and worship/volunteer scheduling boundary
